title: Why Funerals Cost $10,000 (The Grief Upsell, Explained)
alts: The Hidden Casket Markup Funeral Homes Don't Mention
Your Legal Rights When a Funeral Costs $10,000
line1: Why does a funeral cost $10,000? Dave's family faced the bill while still grieving, and it revealed a legal right almost nobody uses.
summary: Dave's family sits down to plan a funeral, still in shock, and the bill quietly climbs past ten thousand dollars. We gently explain the real median cost of a funeral in America (NFDA data), why caskets are so often marked up 100%-300% or more over wholesale, and the FTC Funeral Rule rights almost nobody uses: an itemized price list, the right to buy a casket anywhere else with no extra fee, and phone pricing on request. We cover the psychology of the 'grief upsell' (decision-making changes right after a loss), two common myths (embalming and burial vaults are usually not required by law), why cremation keeps growing, and the fine print behind prepaid 'preneed' funeral plans. This one is handled gently and respectfully - education, not advice.
